title: Appell Sequences in Analytic Number Theory: Shifted Expansions and Dirichlet L-Functions
summary: We place the Appell shift theorem for asymptotic expansions inside a Borel--Laplace framework and apply it to two classical functions of analytic number theory: the Hurwitz zeta function \(ζ(m,q)\) and the Lerch transcendent \(Φ(z,m,a)\). The resulting shifted expansions have coefficients given by Appell polynomials evaluated at the shift, with remainders controlled uniformly on compact sets. The generating sequences are identified explicitly in terms of the Taylor coefficients of the Borel kernels.
